set system host-name [parameter1].explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

set class-of-service forwarding-classes.explanation: The command assigns a forwarding class to a specific queue, mapping traffic to the designated queue for differentiated Quality of Service (QoS) handling.

name [parameter2].explanation: The command `name [parameter2]` assigns a name or label to a configuration element, where `[parameter2]` specifies the desired name or identifier.

dscp [parameter2].explanation: The command `dscp [parameter2]` sets the Differentiated Services Code Point (DSCP) value in the IP header to `[parameter2]` for traffic classification and prioritization.

unit [parameter2].explanation: Configure the unit number of the interface.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit numbers that distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

family inet address [parameter3]/[parame.explanation: Configure IPv4 addresses for interfaces and subnet masks.

parameters.name: ip-address
parameters.explanation: The IPv4 address assigned to the interface.

delete interfaces [parameter1].explanation: The command fragment `delete interfaces [parameter1]` removes the configuration for the specified interface (`[parameter1]`) from the Junos device.
